&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; The&nbsp;Inchcape Seaside Villas&nbsp;</strong></h3>
<p><strong>
	Perched on the western end of Silver Sands Beach reside the Inchcape Seaside Villas.&nbsp;Self contained and self-catering&nbsp;studios, apartments and one free standing house invite travelers to make this very private estate right  on the white sand beach of Silver Sands their home away from home while staying in sunny Barbados.</strong><strong><br></strong><br></p>
<p><strong>Latest and lowest rates are guaranteed for all bookings made directly with us. Please note that&nbsp;there is no flexibility with our booking conditions for all&nbsp;bookings through an Online Tour Operator / third party website. Exceptions (if possible at all)&nbsp;can only be granted for direct bookings with us.</strong><strong><strong><br></strong></strong><br></p>
<h3><strong>Become a “Direct Booking VIP Guest”</strong></h3>
<h4><strong></strong>Enjoy exclusive seasonal promotions and limited-time discounts available <strong>only when booking directly through our website or by contacting us</strong>.<br></h4>
<p>Book directly through our website or&nbsp;reservations office by emailing <strong><a data-start="393" data-end="413" rel="noopener"></a><a href="mailto:rentals@inchcape.net">rentals@inchcape.net</a></strong> and mentioning the <strong>Direct Booking Code: “DIRECT VIP 26”</strong> to receive a <strong>10% discount</strong> on each eligible booking (excluding blackout periods: <strong>November 01 - April 30</strong>).&nbsp;<strong>Can not be combined with any other promotions or discounts.</strong></p>
<p>As a <strong>Direct VIP 26 guest</strong>, you’ll also enjoy our signature <strong>VIP treatment</strong>, which includes:</p>
<ul><li>Personalized airport pick-up at approximately the regular taxi rate</li><li>A warm, concierge-style welcome during office hours</li><li>Rental car arrangements with <strong>VIP delivery</strong> to your apartment</li><li>Seamless WhatsApp communication with our reservations and property management team</li><li>Assistance with event and restaurant reservations</li><li>Late check-outs when possible</li><li>And many more personalized services — too many to list!</li></ul>
<p><strong>Book direct, save more, and experience the difference of true VIP service.</strong><br><strong><br></strong></p>
